summary: Pivot to building "Genz App": an Uber/Bolt-style marketplace that connects clients with nearby service professionals in Kenya (especially Gen Z), with role-based logins, industry-based search, map-based location visibility, pricing/rates display, provider verification, ratings, and customer care access.
architectural_notes: Role-based access control for three user types: provider, client, technical/back-office.
Google Maps integration required for real-time/approximate location display and proximity-based discovery.
Provider onboarding includes document upload and back-office verification workflow.
Marketplace linking model: clients browse providers by category and see rates before engaging.
Reputation system: 5-star ratings after job completion.
In-app customer care contact entry points (e.g., call/SMS/WhatsApp).
Client-side should not reveal provider contact details until provider confirms availability and payment is successful (gated disclosure).
Add M-Pesa STK Push/API payment integration for connection fee collection and payout routing to configured destination.
Update primary phone support contact to +254 723 169 783 (keep payout destination 0791955725).
Add marketing/brand assets support: a designed background theme and an in-app/hosted muted animated demo video for showcasing app flows.
known_issues: Build/deploy failed due to an internal configuration issue (Caffeine).
Uploaded logo appears unclear/blurry in the app UI; needs a clearer 512x512 render for the 40x40 rounded header icon.
Support/contact list UI (Help/Support contacts) was not created/visible as expected.
Landing page CTAs/draft section (e.g., “Get Started”) currently appear unresponsive because they are not wired to any action/navigation.
App still not displaying for the user; likely related to missing/broken logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` causing header image load failure.
User wants the broken/unloaded header logo image removed while keeping the “Genz App” text; current logo asset/load path is still causing a broken image in the header.

Production/live app link https://genz-app.icp0.io not working for user; user reports error feedback (previously seen: “Error 400 – Canister ID Not Resolved”), indicating deployment/canister resolution issue.

Provider self-reported engagement status changes (e.g., set to “Engaged” by provider) are not reflected on the client side (still shows “Not Engaged”); live/near-real-time integration appears not working or not deployed.

Service Provider cannot see the Engaged/Not Engaged engagement toggle on the Provider Profile page; user appears to be seeing an older/outdated UI block instead (likely stale cached frontend or not on latest deployment/version).
Service Provider profile page lacks a visible “Update/Save” action when making changes, preventing providers from submitting updates.

existing_features.title: Create a minimal, working app shell that loads successfully and displays a landing page confirming the app is set up.
Add a simple navigation layout (header + main content area) that can scale to additional pages later.
Implement a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) and apply it consistently across the landing page and navigation. Do not use a blue/purple color scheme.

Rebrand the existing app shell UI to “Genz App” and replace the current landing-page copy with an English, Kenya-focused marketplace description for connecting clients with nearby service professionals (e.g., cleaners, gardeners, dog groomers, plumbers, chefs, electricians).

Implement role-based onboarding and login flow with three user categories: Service Provider, Service Seeker (client), and Technical/Back-office team, using Internet Identity for authentication and backend-stored role selection/assignment.
Create service industries/categories and enable clients to browse and search categories to discover nearby providers offering the selected service.

Add provider profiles that include offered categories, a displayed rate/price, and an approximate location (latitude/longitude) for proximity-based discovery; allow providers to create/update their profile.
Add a map-based location view using Google Maps that displays client and provider locations (with graceful fallback when a Google Maps API key is not configured).

Implement a back-office verification workflow: providers can upload verification documents; Technical/Back-office users can review submissions and mark providers as Verified/Rejected with an optional note; verification status is visible to clients.

Implement a minimal job/linking flow and 5-star rating system: clients can “link/hire” a provider at the displayed rate, mark the job as completed, and submit a 1–5 star rating; provider average rating is displayed in search results and provider details.

Add always-available customer care contact information in the app UI (e.g., header/footer and a persistent “Help/Support” entry) with clearly labeled phone lines; text must be in English and easy to find while using the app.
Generate and use custom static brand images for the Genz App (logo + category icons) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend image serving).

Replace the current Genz App logo asset with the user-uploaded logo image so the header brand icon uses the uploaded logo while keeping the existing asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`. Ensure the resulting logo file is a 512x512 PNG and looks good when rendered as a 40x40 image with rounded corners in the header.
Replace the placeholder support phone number in the in-app Support UI with the user-provided phone support contact: +254 723169783, and ensure it is rendered as a tappable/clickable tel: link.
Ensure a visible "Customer Support" contact list exists in the Support UI (Support drawer) and is accessible from both the header "Support" entry and the footer "Customer Support" entry.
Fix the Genz App logo clarity so it looks sharp when rendered as a 40x40 rounded icon in the header while keeping the asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.

Add a new "Featured Providers" section within the main Landing page content that displays dummy provider profiles for multiple services (at minimum: Architects, Cleaners, Plumbers, Gardeners) and shows a sample rating for each profile.

Increase the visual prominence of the Genz App logo in the header while keeping the existing logo asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`, ensuring the logo remains sharp (not blurry) and does not break the header layout on mobile and desktop.

Update the Landing Page "Featured Providers" dummy provider list to remove the Architect entry and replace it with a Chef entry, including complete dummy profile details (name, category, rate, rating, review count, location, verified flag) consistent with the existing featured provider cards.

Create and apply a fancy, brand-consistent background treatment for the app (at minimum the unauthenticated Landing page), using a generated static background image stored in `frontend/public/assets/generated`, and ensure content remains readable and accessible (sufficient contrast, no interference with cards/text).

Add a muted animated explainer/demo video asset that shows how Genz App works (onboarding, browsing services, map view, hiring/linking, and support), store it as a static file in the frontend public assets, and embed it on the Landing page in a clearly labeled “How it works” / “Demo” section with standard playback controls and a poster image.

Wire up the Landing page hero CTAs so clicks feel immediately responsive: (1) “Get Started” must trigger the real onboarding flow by prompting Internet Identity login if the user is logged out, then proceeding to the existing role-selection onboarding screen; (2) “Learn More” must smoothly scroll/focus to the “See How It Works” (demo video) section.

Make the “See How It Works” demo video section feel more realistic and live by adding interactive controls around the existing video: include a prominent “Play Demo” control overlay (while paused) and a small set of clickable chapter/highlight buttons (e.g., Onboarding, Browse Services, Map View, Hiring/Linking, Support) that seek the video to relevant timestamps and then play.

Add realistic profile images for the dummy/featured provider accounts and render them in the Featured Providers cards (Landing page) as visible avatars/headshots (not generic icons). Images must be stored as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and referenced by filename in the Featured Providers section.

Create a new Landing page section that shows platform adoption stats: number of clients onboard and number of service providers onboard, with an animated count-up/countdown-style effect when the section becomes visible.

Add a provider “preview” step before opening the full Provider Detail view that shows (a) the provider’s engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged) and (b) the provider’s current/approximate location with an option to view it on Google Maps.

Gate access to full provider profile information—especially the contacts section—behind a successful connection-fee payment equal to 10% of the provider’s displayed rate, and prompt the client to pay before they can view full details.

Add an M-Pesa payment initiation + verification workflow for the 10% connection fee, integrated via a configurable M-Pesa API (STK Push style), and use the verification result to unlock provider details.
After a provider is unlocked, expose communication options: a clickable call action (tel: link) and an in-app messaging interface for client↔provider communication.

Remove the Landing page “How it works”/demo area by deleting the embedded demo video section from the Landing page and updating the hero CTA behavior so there is no longer any scroll-to-demo interaction.

Update the “Join Our Growing Community” stats section to show realistic adoption numbers by enforcing a minimum display of over 200,000 clients and about 150,000 service providers, while still using backend values if they exceed those thresholds.

Add provider profile picture upload during provider profile setup/editing, storing the uploaded image in the backend and displaying it in provider-facing and client-facing provider views where profile pictures are shown.

Add separate provider document upload sections for (1) Academic qualification documents and (2) Certificate of Good Conduct, and make these documents available to back-office users for review as part of the provider verification workflow.

Create a testimonials section using dummy testimonials tied to service providers (including the existing dummy/featured provider identities), and render it as a new Landing page section for social proof.

Update the Landing page “Join Our Growing Community” stats section so it always displays a realistic minimum that is strictly greater than 200,000 for “Clients Onboard” and approximately 150,000 for “Service Providers Onboard”, while still displaying backend-provided totals whenever they exceed those minimum thresholds.

Regenerate the existing Genz App logo image at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` so it is a crisp, sharp 512×512 PNG that still looks clear when rendered as a small rounded app icon in the header (e.g., ~40×40 to ~80×80 CSS pixels).

Replace the existing static logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` with a regenerated, crisp 512×512 PNG derived from the user-uploaded image `Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview.png`, ensuring the header logo no longer shows a broken-image icon and remains sharp when rendered at small sizes (approximately 40×40 to 80×80 CSS pixels) with rounded corners on light backgrounds.

Replace the current Genz App logo by regenerating the existing static logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` with a new proposed logo design that borrows key visual ideas from the user’s original logo (overall concept, recognizable motifs, and brand feel) while still being an original, clean, modern mark appropriate for a Kenyan services marketplace.

Verify and adjust (if needed) the header logo rendering so the new logo remains visually clear and well-aligned across breakpoints without changing the logo asset path and without breaking the header layout on mobile and desktop.

Update the header brand area to keep the visible text “Genz App”, but remove the broken/unloaded logo image from rendering when the logo asset fails to load (so users do not see a broken image icon). Keep the existing logo asset path (`/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`) so a logo can be manually replaced later by uploading a valid file to that path without requiring further code changes.

Add a secondary brand image element in the header brand area so the uploaded mark can appear immediately to the right of the visible “Genz App” text (i.e., order becomes: main app logo icon (if loaded) → “Genz App” text → secondary mark image).

Add the user-uploaded image asset `Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview-2.png` to the app as a static frontend asset under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` (optionally also create a compact, header-friendly variant) and reference it from the Header component for the new right-of-name brand mark.

Update the Header secondary brand image (the logo shown to the right of the “Genz App” text) so it renders the provided logo image exactly as-is with no resizing: do not apply Tailwind sizing classes (e.g., h-*, w-*), do not set width/height attributes, and do not apply CSS that forces scaling (including object-fit sizing that implies down/up-scaling). Use the provided uploaded logo asset path `/assets/generated/Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview-2.png` for this right-of-name logo image.

Adjust the header layout so the right-of-name logo image (rendered at its intrinsic size) is not clipped or overlapped by the header container (e.g., remove or relax fixed header height constraints that would crop the image), while keeping the header usable and the navigation/login controls accessible.

Add the newly uploaded logo image file `Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview-3.png` to `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and update the Header secondary brand image (to the right of the visible “Genz App” text) to use `/assets/generated/Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview-3.png` as its `src`, rendering the image at its intrinsic size with no resizing (no Tailwind h-*/w-* classes, no width/height attributes, and no CSS such as object-fit that forces scaling).

Update the Landing page "Join Our Growing Community" animated stats so the minimum displayed figures are 200,000 for "Clients Onboard" and 250,000 for "Service Providers Onboard", while still displaying backend-provided totals whenever they exceed those minimum thresholds.
Add PWA installability metadata by creating a web app manifest and linking it from the app HTML so mobile browsers can offer “Install to Home Screen” for Genz App.
Add a service worker that enables basic PWA behavior for installability and provides safe, minimal offline support for the static app shell without interfering with authenticated API calls.

Implement an in-app install prompt UI that appears only when installation is available, and provide clear manual “Add to Home Screen” instructions for iOS Safari where the standard install prompt is not available.
Update `frontend/index.html` with appropriate PWA-related meta tags for better mobile install experience.

Add an IC domain verification file at `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` that includes the domain `genz-app.icp0.io` so the boundary node can recognize the domain and route requests to the correct canister.
Ensure the `.well-known` domain verification path is not broken by the service worker caching strategy and is always fetched from network (or safely served) without causing navigation failures.

Add a simple public troubleshooting/help section in the unauthenticated Landing page that explains, in English, what to do if the user sees “Canister ID Not Resolved”, including the correct URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` and instructions to remove old bookmarks/shortcuts and retry.

Remove the entire “Troubleshooting Access Issues” section from the unauthenticated Landing page, including its heading, explanatory text about “Canister ID Not Resolved” / “Error 400”, the displayed URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io`, and the step-by-step instructions list.

Clean up any unused imports or code left behind by removing the troubleshooting section from `frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx` (for example, remove the `AlertCircle` icon import if it is no longer used).

Add a new section on the unauthenticated main Landing page that lets users quickly choose who they are with three prominent buttons: “Service Provider”, “Client”, and “Technical Team” (use English labels).

Wire the three Landing page role buttons to a fast navigation flow: (1) if the user is logged out, prompt Internet Identity login; (2) after successful login, take the user directly into role onboarding with the selected role pre-selected so the user can immediately press “Continue”.

If the user is already authenticated and already has a role assigned, the Landing page role buttons must route directly to the correct role home area for “easy and fast maneuvers”: Client → Browse Services (Categories page), Service Provider → My Profile (Provider Profile page), Technical Team → Review Verifications (Verification Review page).

Add a provider-facing section on the Service Provider profile page (My Provider Profile) that lets a provider choose and save their current engagement status with two options: “Engaged” and “Not Engaged”, using clear English labels and helper text.
Update the frontend backend-bindings usage and React Query mutation code so provider profile saves include the new engagement status value and remain type-safe with the generated candid types.

Expand the browseable service categories list so it covers a comprehensive set of common services in Kenya, with a strong emphasis on technical/vocational trades ("technical courses") such as electrical work, plumbing, carpentry, welding/metal work, masonry, tiling, painting, appliance repair, phone/computer repair, networking/CCTV, solar installation, and auto/motorbike repair, while keeping all user-facing labels in English.

Update the Service Provider profile “Service Category” selector to reflect the expanded Kenya services list, prioritizing technical/vocational trade options, and ensure the selected option is saved correctly to the backend `BusinessType` value.
Add and use static category icon assets for any newly introduced service categories, ensuring each category card in “Browse Services” displays a non-broken icon image.
Add a visible “Home” button/link in the app header (heading section) that navigates the user back to the Home/Landing page.

Ensure the Header receives working navigation props (currentPage and onNavigate) in both authenticated and unauthenticated app states so the Home button works consistently whenever a navigation handler exists.

Implement a near-real-time (“instant”) engagement-status notification experience between client and provider by refreshing provider engagement state automatically while the client is viewing that provider, and showing a clear in-app notification when the status changes between “Engaged” and “Not Engaged”.

Create and display a clear 1–5 star rating UI for service providers across client-facing provider surfaces, using English labels and consistent visuals (stars), including an explicit empty-state when a provider has no ratings yet.

Ensure provider engagement status updates are persisted immediately when a Service Provider toggles “Engaged / Not Engaged”, without requiring the provider to click “Save Profile”, by wiring the engagement radio-group in `frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProfilePage.tsx` to the existing backend method `updateEngagementStatus(isEngaged)` via the existing React Query hook `useUpdateEngagementStatus()`.

Make client-side engagement status views reliably refresh from real backend data by ensuring all relevant React Query caches are invalidated/refetched after a provider updates engagement status, including the specific provider preview query key used by clients (`['providerPreview', principal]`) and any provider detail queries currently showing engagement status.

Add a lightweight “last updated” / “Live status” UX cue on the client provider preview dialog so users can trust the status is live (English text), and ensure the preview continues polling while the dialog is open (keep the existing 3-second interval behavior).

Create dedicated Client and Service Provider access screens in the frontend with clear sections for “Log in” and “Create new account”, and include a required phone-number OTP verification step for both roles.

Add an always-available pinned location update experience for both Clients and Service Providers in the frontend, using the existing LocationPicker component to let users set/update their current pinned location quickly.
Add React Query hooks and type-safe frontend bindings for the new OTP and pinned-location backend methods, and ensure role-based authorization errors are handled with user-friendly English messages.

Update the Service Provider profile UI to make engagement status interactive: allow toggling Engaged/Not Engaged and, when Engaged is selected, require the provider to set the number of hours they will remain engaged; persist changes immediately via the backend (no 'future update' placeholder text).

Update client-facing provider surfaces to visibly show engagement openness: display Engaged/Not Engaged plus the remaining engaged time (when engaged end time exists) in the Provider Preview dialog and Provider Detail page.

Make the engagement status feel 'live' to clients by polling provider data while the Provider Preview dialog is open and while the Provider Detail page is visible, and update the UI immediately when the engagement status or remaining time changes.

Ensure the Service Provider "Engagement Status" control renders as an interactive Engaged/Not Engaged toggle (with hours input) on the Provider Profile page, and remove/avoid showing any outdated placeholder copy such as “Note: Engagement status updates will be available in a future update.”

Fix service worker caching so users reliably receive the latest frontend bundle after a deployment (prevent stale UI that hides the engagement toggle). Update the service worker cache versioning strategy so older caches are invalidated on new deployments.

Add an in-app “Update available” UX so when a new service worker is installed/activated, the app prompts the user in English to refresh/reload to get the latest version, and provides a one-click action to reload.

Update the Service Provider profile experience so that, immediately after a Service Provider logs in and navigates to “My Profile” (Provider Profile page), they first see a read-only summary of their provider information (no editable inputs by default).
Add a clear provider-facing action button labeled “Change Info” on the Provider Profile summary view that switches the page into an edit mode for allowed fields.

In Provider Profile edit mode, add an explicit “Update” (or “Save Changes”) button that becomes enabled only when there are changes and persists the changes to the backend; show clear English success/error feedback.

Enforce that provider bio-data (identity details sourced from an ID document) is not editable in the app by making those fields read-only in both summary and edit experiences, and by enforcing the same restriction server-side so attempts to modify bio-data are ignored or rejected.

Replace/remove the outdated Provider Profile copy that says profile editing will be available in a future update, and ensure the Provider Profile page messaging matches the new summary-first + Change Info + Update flow.

Replace the empty/mock provider list on the Client "Provider Results" page with real backend data so a logged-in client can see every service provider for the selected category (and also support viewing "All Providers" when no category filter is provided).
Update the client provider listing UI so each provider card clearly shows engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged) in English, for every provider in the results grid.

Add React Query wiring for the new/updated provider list query and integrate it into `frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResultsPage.tsx`, including loading and error states with English user-facing text.

new_feature_requests.summary: Define three main login/user categories: Service Providers, Service Seekers (clients), and Technical/Back-office team.
Create service industries/categories (e.g., cleaning, gardening, dog grooming, plumbing, chef, electrician) that users can browse/search to find providers.
Enable location-based discovery and display of client/provider locations using Google Maps integration.
Show provider rates/pricing to clients for linking/hiring a specific service provider.
Back-office verification flow for service providers to upload documents, and for the technical team to review/verify (especially for specialized services).
Post-job client rating system using 5-star ratings for service providers.
Add user-friendly customer care/contact lines accessible within the app.
Hide service provider contact details from clients until a connection is approved (availability confirmation) and any required fee is paid.
Add provider availability confirmation step: when a client requests to contact a provider, the system asks the provider to confirm availability before sharing contact details.
Implement a 10% connection fee charged to the client (based on the provider’s quoted rate) before releasing provider contact details.
Integrate M-Pesa payments (STK Push/API) to automatically collect the 10% connection fee and route funds to a configured payout destination (bank/M-Pesa).
Add admin-configurable payout and primary support contact settings (provided payout: 0791955725; main contact: 0795532919).
Use the user-provided uploaded image as the Genz App logo in the UI (replace generated logo asset).
Add dummy provider profiles on the main page (e.g., architects, cleaners, plumbers, gardeners) showing sample ratings for preview/demo purposes.
Adjust the Genz App logo usage in the UI to render it intelligently larger (improve visual prominence while keeping it crisp).
Update the dummy/featured provider profiles on the landing page: remove the Architect profile, replace it with a Chef profile, and create the Chef dummy profile details.
Create a fancier/more visually engaging background for the app (landing page/UI) to improve branding and presentation.

Wire up the Landing page “Get Started” (and any currently non-responsive draft/demo CTAs) to a real action flow (e.g., role selection → login/onboarding) so clicks provide immediate, visible response.
Add realistic profile images/avatars for the dummy/featured provider accounts (use generated static assets and render them in the provider cards).
Create a landing-page stats section showing number of clients and service providers onboard, with an animated count-up/countdown-style effect.

Add a backend query API to return platform counts for the Landing page stats section (total client profiles count and total provider profiles count) in a way that works for anonymous users viewing the Landing page.
Show provider engagement/availability status (e.g., Engaged vs Not Engaged) on the provider preview/listing before viewing the full profile.
Allow clients to view a provider’s current/approximate location on Google Maps from the preview/listing before unlocking the full profile.
Gate/unlock the full provider profile details (especially contacts) behind a successful M-Pesa payment of a 10% connection fee based on the provider’s rate.
Add client↔provider communication options after unlock: clickable calling (tel link/online calling entry point) and an in-app messaging/chat platform.
Implement a backend-derived provider engagement status that clients can see in provider preview/listing, based on whether the provider currently has an active (requested or in-progress) job.
During provider onboarding/profile setup, add specific document upload sections for academic qualification documents and Certificate of Good Conduct for back-office review as part of verification.
Add a provider profile picture upload/selection section during provider onboarding/profile setup so provider accounts look more real.
Create a testimonials section for service providers (including dummy accounts/testimonials) to display social proof in the app/landing experience.
Update the “Join Our Growing Community” stats section to show realistic adoption numbers beyond 200,000 clients and around 150,000 service providers (enforce minimum display thresholds).
Remove the current uploaded/logo asset and create a new proposed Genz App logo inspired by (borrowing ideas from) the user’s original logo; update the app to use the new logo asset.

Allow removing the broken/unloaded header logo image while keeping the “Genz App” text in the header (graceful fallback when logo asset is missing), and support manual replacement later by uploading a final logo and wiring it to `/assets/generated/`.
Place the provided logo image in the header to the right of the “Genz App” text (brand area layout update).
Place the provided logo image to the right of the “Genz App” text exactly as-is (no resizing/cropping), using the original uploaded asset.
Update the Landing page animated adoption stats to display 200k Clients Onboard and 250k Service Providers (as the shown figures).
Set up PWA “Install to Home Screen” flow so Genz App can be installed on a phone like a native app icon (web app installability).
Remove the “Troubleshooting Access Issues” section (Canister ID Not Resolved/Error 400 guidance and correct URL instructions) from the Landing page.
Add a Landing page section with quick role selection buttons (Service Provider, Client, Technical Team) that route users into the correct login/onboarding flow for faster navigation.
In the Service Provider area, add a section/control for providers to indicate their current engagement status (Engaged vs Not Engaged).
Persist a provider’s self-reported engagement status in the backend provider profile data model, and expose it through existing profile read APIs so the frontend can load and display the saved value.

Expand and refine the Kenya services/categories list to be comprehensive, with emphasis on technical courses/trades (e.g., technical skills and vocational services) included in the browseable industries.
Add a prominent Home button in the app header/heading area that navigates back to the Home/Landing page for easier navigation.
Allow service providers to upload/share photos of completed work (portfolio/gallery) within their profile for clients to view.
Add per-job feedback: after each job, clients can rate that specific job and mark outcome as “Satisfied” or “Unsatisfied”; display these job-level ratings/feedback in the provider’s history/profile.
Add real-time/instant engagement status updates between service providers and clients (live connection that notifies clients when a provider becomes Engaged/Not Engaged).
Ensure the backend engagement status update API is complete and reliably persists provider engagement status changes so clients can observe the updated value through existing read/query APIs.

Verify and fix (if needed) the backend engagement status update implementation so `updateEngagementStatus(isEngaged)` updates the caller’s stored `ProviderProfile.isEngaged` and the new value is returned by `getProviderPreview(provider)` and `providerHasEngagedJob(provider)` for all users (including clients).
Add dedicated Client and Service Provider authentication flows with “Log in” and “Create new account”, using mobile-number OTP verification for account verification.
Allow both Clients and Service Providers to always update their current pinned location (for efficiency in discovery/servicing).

Add backend support for phone-number OTP verification for both Client and Service Provider accounts, including APIs to (1) start an OTP verification for a given phone number and role, and (2) verify an OTP code to mark that phone number as verified for the authenticated caller.
Persist phone verification state in backend profile data so the app can enforce that Clients and Service Providers must have a verified phone number before being considered fully onboarded.

Add backend support for “pinned location” for Clients and lightweight update APIs so both Clients and Service Providers can update their current pinned location at any time without needing to resubmit the entire profile payload.

Add provider-set engagement duration: when a provider marks themselves Engaged (e.g., upon accepting a job), they can specify hours/time-until-available; client views should show Engaged/Not Engaged plus the remaining engaged time and auto-return to Not Engaged when the time elapses (kept in sync live).

Extend the backend ProviderProfile data model to support an optional engagement time window so a Service Provider can be marked Engaged until a specific time, in addition to the existing boolean engagement status.
Implement backend APIs for providers to set and clear their engagement status with a duration (hours) so the provider can mark themselves Engaged for N hours, and can manually Disengage early.

Ensure backend provider-read endpoints return an engagement state that automatically becomes Not Engaged once the engagement end time has passed, so clients always see an accurate Engaged/Not Engaged status without manual provider action.
On Service Provider login, show a read-only summary view of their profile first; provide a clear “Change Info” button to enter edit mode for allowed fields.
Enforce that provider bio-data (identity details sourced from ID document) is not editable in the app; only non-bio fields can be changed via the edit flow.

Add/extend a backend query API that returns a list of provider profiles suitable for client browsing (including each provider’s current engagement state), and ensure it is callable by authenticated clients.
